preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 2 and 500, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 0 and the maximum possible number of roads, inclusive.
The city numbers are between 1 and n, inclusive.
No road connects a city to itself.
The length of each road is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains n * (n - 1) / 2 integers, one for each pair of cities s and t where s < t.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= cst <= m for cst in output)
postconditions.description: Each output integer is between 0 and the number of roads, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == output[i + n * (n - 1) / 2 - i - 1] for i in range(n * (n - 1) / 2 // 2))
postconditions.description: The output is symmetric, with cst = cts for all s < t.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == 0 if not is_path(i, i + 1, n, m, roads) else output[i] == count_roads(i, i + 1, n, m, roads) for i in range(n * (n - 1) / 2 - 1))
postconditions.description: For each pair of cities s and t, the output integer is the number of roads that lie on at least one shortest path from s to t.
